title: Energetic and structural dynamic drivers of transcription factor MycMax, Omomyc homodimer, and MaxMax recognition on DNA.
one_liner_zh: 该文通过微秒级MD模拟和MMGBSA能量分析，系统研究了MycMax、Omomyc和MaxMax二聚体与E-box及polyA DNA的识别机制，聚焦TF-DNA结合界面动态与能量驱动因素，与本课题高度匹配。
abstract: Basic helix-loop-helix leucine zipper (bHLHLZ) transcription factors (TFs), such as MycMax, MaxMax, and the engineered mutant Omomyc dimers, regulate gene expression by binding to the E-box (5'-CACGTG-3') motif in DNA. Here, we used microsecond molecular dynamics (MD) simulations along with MMGBSA energetic and hydrogen bonding (HB) analyses to investigate how MycMax, Omomyc, and MaxMax dimers interact with both canonical E-box and homogeneous polyA reference sequences. Our MD results indicate that protein-DNA van der Waals (VDW) interactions and surface complementarity dominate the binding affinity measurements. Per-residue decomposition underscores the central role of conserved arginine residues at the protein-DNA binding interface, while HB information readout (or KL divergence) analyses reveal a biased DNA strand association that reinforces protein sequence recognition for specificity. Although MaxMax binds to the canonical E-box energetically stably, it loses the stability on polyA DNA more than the other two TFs, suggesting an essential reliance of MaxMax on the E-box motif for TF-DNA interaction coordination. MycMax exhibits moderate stability energetically and shows more variable dynamical responses to local DNA sequences. In contrast, the Omomyc dimer retains slightly higher binding affinity or energetic stability than MycMax on both E-box and polyA DNA, suggesting an enhanced ability to sequester MycMax in oncogenic settings. These findings provide new physical insights into dimeric bHLHLZ-TFs on DNA recognition and reveal potential strategies for targeting Myc-driven transcription or overexpression in cancer.
abstract_zh: 碱性螺旋-环-螺旋亮氨酸拉链（basic helix-loop-helix leucine zipper, bHLHLZ）转录因子（transcription factors, TFs），如MycMax、MaxMax以及工程化突变体Omomyc二聚体，通过结合DNA中的E-box（5'-CACGTG-3'）基序来调控基因表达。在此，我们使用微秒级分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟，结合MMGBSA能量分析和氢键（hydrogen bonding, HB）分析，研究了MycMax、Omomyc和MaxMax二聚体如何与经典E-box及均质polyA参考序列相互作用。我们的MD结果表明，蛋白质-DNA范德华（van der Waals, VDW）相互作用和表面互补性主导了结合亲和力测量。逐残基分解强调了蛋白质-DNA结合界面处保守精氨酸残基的核心作用，而HB信息读出（或KL散度）分析揭示了一种偏向性的DNA链关联，这增强了蛋白质序列识别的特异性。尽管MaxMax在能量上稳定地结合经典E-box，但它在polyA DNA上失去稳定性的程度大于其他两种转录因子，表明MaxMax对E-box基序在TF-DNA相互作用协调中具有关键依赖性。MycMax在能量上表现出中等稳定性，并对局部DNA序列显示出更多变的动态响应。相比之下，Omomyc二聚体在E-box和polyA DNA上均比MycMax保留略高的结合亲和力或能量稳定性，表明其在致癌环境中具有增强的隔离MycMax的能力。这些发现为二聚体bHLHLZ-TFs在DNA识别方面提供了新的物理见解，并揭示了靶向癌症中Myc驱动的转录或过表达的潜在策略。
